recognize_zh: 背部臨床照片可見大範圍、幾乎融合的深紫褐色色素沉著斑塊，局部皮膚苔蘚化並有細屑，界線不清且分布廣泛，符合蕈狀肉芽腫斑塊期至紅皮症樣的皮膚表現（深色膚色中紅斑常呈紫褐色）。
features: Clinical photograph of the back showing extensive, near-confluent involvement
Ill-defined dusky violaceous to dark brown hyperpigmented patches and thin plaques
Areas of lichenification with fine scale, including paraspinal and lower back regions
Scattered small lighter, hypopigmented-appearing zones between patches
No discrete exophytic tumors or ulcerations
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the back shows extensive, ill-defined, near-confluent dusky violaceous-brown patches and thin plaques with areas of lichenification and fine scale, interspersed with small lighter areas. No tumors or ulcers are evident. In darkly pigmented skin, erythema of patch/plaque or erythrodermic disease often appears violaceous or hyperpigmented rather than red. This is a clinical image and is nonspecific by itself; in this context it is compatible with widespread cutaneous mycosis fungoides approaching erythroderma.

ddx.vs: Eczema is typically pruritic with flexural predominance and biopsy shows spongiosis without epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes or a clonal T-cell population.

ddx.dx: Drug eruption or erythroderma due to other causes (psoriasis, PRP)
ddx.vs: Other erythrodermas lack Sezary cells, CD4:CD8 >10, and CD7/CD26 loss on blood flow cytometry.
Postinflammatory pigmentation is flat without active scale or induration and shows only dermal melanophages on biopsy.
Tinea shows annular lesions with an active scaly border and hyphae on KOH preparation or PAS stain.
